tools.name: get_oi_board
tools.description:
Per-venue open-interest ranking for a perp symbol (e.g. BTCUSDT): OI in
    coins and USD, market share %, 1h/4h/24h OI change % and USD flow, and
    OI / 24h-volume ratio per exchange, plus market totals.

tools.name: get_cash_flows

    recently closed trades with realized PnL.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_liquidation_cascades, get_liquidations_summary, get_api_key, list_alerts · Private data: get_token_unlocks, get_api_key, create_alert, list_alerts, delete_alert · Public sink: get_microstructure, get_oi_board, get_arbitrum_perps, get_api_key, list_alerts, delete_alert · Destructive: get_hl_liquidation_map, explain_market, delete_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_liquidation_cascades, get_liquidations_summary, get_api_key, list_alerts · Private data: get_token_unlocks, get_api_key, create_alert, list_alerts, delete_alert · Public sink: get_microstructure, get_oi_board, get_arbitrum_perps, get_api_key, list_alerts, delete_alert · Destructive: get_hl_liquidation_map, explain_market, delete_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
